title: Pure Snake-Eye
summary: Pure Snake-Eye FIRE control strategy centered around placing monsters from the field or graveyard into the Spell and Trap Zone as Continuous Spells and converting parked cards into explosive summons. Without outside engines like Diabellstar or the Forbidden Original Sinful Spoils, the deck relies purely on archetype synergy and FIRE Link climbers.

summary.title: Starters
points: Snake-Eye Ash searches any Level 1 FIRE monster from your Deck on Normal or Special Summon, and sends itself and another face-up card you control to the GY to Special Summon a Snake-Eye monster from your Deck.

Snake-Eyes Poplar Special Summons itself from the hand whenever it is added to your hand, searches a Snake-Eye Spell or Trap on summon, and places itself into the Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell when sent to the GY.
Snake-Eye Oak adds or Special Summons a Level 1 FIRE monster from your GY or banishment on summon, and sends 2 face-up cards to the GY to Special Summon a Snake-Eye monster from your Deck.

Divine Temple of the Snake-Eye places a Snake-Eye monster from your hand, Deck, or GY into the Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell on activation, and Special Summons a parked monster when your opponent summons.

summary.title: Opening: Snake-Eye Ash
steps: Normal Summon Snake-Eye Ash and activate its effect to search Snake-Eyes Poplar from your Deck.
Trigger Snake-Eyes Poplar in hand to Special Summon itself, searching Divine Temple of the Snake-Eye on summon.
Activate Divine Temple of the Snake-Eye to place Snake-Eye Oak from your Deck into the Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.
Activate Snake-Eye Ash's second effect, sending Ash and Poplar to the GY to Special Summon Snake-Eyes Flamberge Dragon from your Deck.
Trigger Poplar's GY effect to place itself into the Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, providing continuous fuel for Flamberge Dragon and Link plays.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Snake-Eyes Flamberge Dragon targets 1 face-up monster on the field or in either GY and places it face-up in its owner's Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, and when sent to the GY, revives two Level 1 FIRE monsters with different names.
Snake-Eyes Doomed Dragon Special Summons itself by sending 2 Monster Cards from your Spell and Trap Zone to the GY, and places an opponent's face-up monster into the Spell and Trap Zone.
Snake-Eyes Vengeance Dragon places a face-up monster from either field or GY into the Spell and Trap Zone during either player's Main Phase as a Quick Effect.
Promethean Princess, Bestower of Flames revives a FIRE monster from your GY, and destroys an opponent's Special Summoned monster alongside a FIRE monster you control as a Quick Effect from the GY.
S:P Little Knight banishes a card on the field or GY on Link Summon and temporarily banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye places any face-up monster on the field into the Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell without destroying it.
Startling Stare of the Snake-Eyes places an opponent's face-up monster into the Spell and Trap Zone, or Special Summons a monster from the Spell and Trap Zone to your field.
Dramatic Snake-Eye Chase places Snake-Eyes Diabellstar from your hand, Deck, or GY into the Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Original Sinful Spoils - Snake-Eye is Forbidden in the TCG, and the WANTED and Diabellstar the Black Witch engine is excluded to keep the list purely focused on Snake-Eye monsters.

main: Snake-Eye Ash
Starter: searches a Level 1 FIRE; sends two cards to summon a Snake-Eye from the Deck.
Snake-Eyes Poplar
Summons itself when added to the hand; searches a Snake-Eye Spell/Trap.
Snake-Eye Oak
Recovers or revives a Level 1 FIRE; sends two cards to summon a Snake-Eye.
Snake-Eye Birch
Summons itself next to a FIRE; summons a Snake-Eye on their turn.
Snake-Eyes Flamberge Dragon
Parks a monster as a Continuous Spell; revives two Level 1 FIREs when it leaves.
Snake-Eyes Diabellstar
Parks itself and an attacker; comes back by parking a FIRE.
Divine Temple of the Snake-Eye
Field Spell: parks a Snake-Eye, then summons it when they summon.
Sinful Spoils of Subversion - Snake-Eye
Parks any face-up monster as a Continuous Spell.
Dramatic Snake-Eye Chase
Quick-Play: parks Snake-Eyes Diabellstar from the Deck.
Startling Stare of the Snake-Eyes
Parks one of their monsters, or summons a parked one to your field.
